method: Visual inspection of the final neutral fitted PNGs, with geometry checks recorded separately in verification.json and pose_audit.json.

images.01_Porch_closed.png: Full room lettering, paired leaves, exterior reveal and window fit; closed threshold visible.
images.02_Porch_open.png: Independent inward leaves and entry into the prepared room; no porch swing obstruction.
images.03_Inside_door.png: Interior leaf plane, seals, latch hardware and raised privacy blind.
images.04_Room_toward_cot.png: Reserved cot position, pillow/blanket, west storage and chair; organized uncluttered room.
images.05_Cupboards_open.png: Blanket and first-aid interiors visible with independently opened doors.
images.06_Stretcher_folded.png: Complete folded silhouette, separated halves, released sleeves, nested legs and wall supports.
images.07_Stretcher_deployed.png: Separate transport stretcher, carrying grips, restraints, hinge construction and floor-supported legs beside the cot.
images.08_Handling_overhead.png: Roof-hidden neutral plan, inward leaves and usable entrance/turning area; see handling_plan.svg for sampled route overlay diagram.
images.09_Window_inside.png: Separate glazing, frame, sill, raised blind, pull and cleat; shared porch rails visible through glazing.
images.10_Threshold_inside.png: Low metal threshold with one finished top surface at the slab transition.
images.11_Radio_heater.png: Analog radio controls and connected handset cord; physical thermostat and connected heater conduit.

limits: Neutral Blender review. Shared shell remains the approved blockout. No Unreal rendering/collision certification; materials require later baking/export review.
